offline_online_convergence.interpretation: Both descriptive point estimates are 0.05 on the same 20-instance cohort, but this is not an independently powered validation and does not establish a causal mediation path.

exploratory_cross_cohort_selector_headro.bound_scope: For each audited run, this is a deterministic upper bound on improvement by any selector whose output support is restricted to the 15 persisted round-agent candidates. The bootstrap interval concerns generalization to similar tasks, not uncertainty in the realized-pool bound.
exploratory_cross_cohort_selector_headro.analysis_status: Outcome-aware exploratory synthesis selected after cohort-specific results were inspected; not a preregistered primary endpoint.

completeness_proxy.interpretation: Association between within-cohort length-component variation and a well-formed final; not a causal mediation estimate.

scope_guard: Outcome-aware secondary reanalysis of frozen cached cohorts; no prospective method claim.
